Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of neck pain with an easy step-by-step guide.

This video will show the best method towards healing a neck muscle injury, including what to do first and what exercises (and stretches) are the most effective. 

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give neck pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix your neck pain!
